g.text: FRONTIER ML MODEL TAXONOMY & BENCHMARK MATRIX
Comprehensive Architectural Lineage for Optovue Solix Peripapillary RNFL Volumetric OCT Segmentation
High inter-slice jitter along slow axis.
Inference Planes: Fast X-Z & Slow Y-Z
Boundary Injection: Stem Skip f1 (Full Res)
KEY ARCHITECTURAL FINDINGS & MODEL TAXONOMY LESSONS
Upgrading Single-Planar 1.6M → 6.5M in single-planar mode only
Bi-Planar Orthogonal Consensus Fusion jumped Dice to 0.9518
and slashed median MABE from 12.58 to 4.71 µm.
Dense 3D U-Net is an Anisotropic Outlier Shield
Dense 3D U-Net operates across 3D voxels, eliminating
single-slice drift. While Bi-Planar has the lower median error
(4.71 vs 5.50 µm), Dense 3D achieves lower mean MABE (5.87 µm)
and the lowest worst-case cohort scan error (17.02 µm).
What Was Missed: Canonical STN Model
Patient head tilt introduces severe diagonal artifacts.
bounding boundary drift below <0.8 µm under stress rotation.
